description:
Ji-Su and Hyeon-Oh have been dating for three years. One day, Hyeon-Oh, who had gone abroad for language studies, suddenly tells Ji-Su he won't return on the promised date, leaving him disappointed. Ji-Su happens to celebrate his birthday at the home of his current tutoring student. Angry at Hyeon-Oh for always playing pranks on him, Ji-Su teases Hyeon-Jae, asking if he wants to find the piercings on his body. Hyeon-Jae, who has a crush on Ji-Su, begins searching for each piercing with his lips. But then, Hyeon-Oh, who was supposed to be abroad, suddenly appears before them....

 *“You said if you were going to do it with someone else, you'd show me first. Right?”*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
